# CloudSync Terms of Service

**Last Updated:** October 26, 2023

### 1. Definitions
In these Terms of Service, the term "Service" refers collectively to the CloudSync software platform, including all features, functionality, APIs, and documentation provided by CloudSync Inc. to Users. "User" denotes any individual or entity that creates an account to access or utilize the Service, while "Customer" specifically refers to the legal entity that enters into a subscription agreement for the Service. "Content" encompasses all data, files, documents, and information uploaded, stored, or generated by the User within the Service environment.

The term "Subscribers" refers to the specific individuals or roles granted access to the Service by the Customer under their administrative account. "Third-Party Services" are any external applications, platforms, or services that integrate with CloudSync via APIs or plugins, which are not owned, operated, or controlled by CloudSync Inc. "Personal Data" is defined as any information that identifies or can be used to identify a natural person, processed in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

These definitions are integral to understanding the scope of this agreement and the respective rights and obligations of both CloudSync Inc. and the User. Any capitalized terms not explicitly defined herein shall have the meanings assigned to them in the specific section where they appear or as commonly understood in the software-as-a-service industry. By accessing or using the Service, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these definitions and the terms contained within this document.

To access the Service, you must register for an account by providing accurate, current, and complete information as requested during the sign-up process. You are solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials, including your username and password, and for all activities that occur under your account. You agree to notify CloudSync immediately upon any unauthorized use of your account or any other breach of security.

CloudSync reserves the right to suspend or terminate your account if we have reasonable grounds to believe that you have violated these Terms, provided false information during registration, or engaged in fraudulent activity. We may also require additional verification steps to confirm your identity or the legitimacy of your account. Upon termination, you will lose access to all Content and features associated with the account, and CloudSync is under no obligation to preserve or return any data stored within the Service.

You warrant that you are at least the age of majority in your jurisdiction or have obtained parental or guardian consent to use the Service. We reserve the right to limit the number of accounts created by a single user or organization to prevent abuse of the Service's resources and to ensure fair usage for all Customers.

### 3. Payment Terms
All fees for the Service are billed in advance on a recurring basis, corresponding to the subscription plan selected by the Customer at the time of purchase. Prices are listed in the currency specified on our pricing page and are subject to change with reasonable notice, typically provided thirty (30) days prior to the effective date of any increase. Unless otherwise stated in a separate written agreement, all fees are non-refundable, and no credits will be issued for unused portions of a billing cycle.

The Customer is responsible for paying all applicable taxes, duties, and fees associated with the Service, excluding sales taxes that CloudSync is legally required to collect. Payment must be made using a valid payment method authorized by the Customer, and CloudSync reserves the right to charge the payment method on file at the start of each billing cycle. If a payment fails, CloudSync may suspend the Service until the outstanding balance is resolved, and late fees may apply as outlined in the specific subscription agreement.

Customers may upgrade or downgrade their subscription plans at any time, with changes taking effect at the beginning of the next billing cycle. If a Customer cancels their subscription, access to the Service will continue until the end of the current paid period, after which the account will be deactivated. CloudSync Inc. is not liable for any business losses or damages resulting from the interruption of service due to non-payment or administrative processing delays.

Users agree to use the Service only for lawful purposes and in a manner that does not infringe the rights of, restrict, or inhibit anyone else's use and enjoyment of the Service. You are strictly prohibited from uploading, transmitting, or storing any Content that contains malware, viruses, or any other harmful code, or that facilitates unauthorized access to computer systems. Furthermore, you may not use the Service to spam, harass, defraud, or engage in any other illegal or unethical activities.

You must not attempt to reverse engineer, decompile, disassemble, or derive the source code of the Service, except to the extent expressly permitted by applicable law. Accessing the Service through automated means, such as bots, scrapers, or spiders, without prior written consent from CloudSync is strictly forbidden. Additionally, you may not use the Service to host or distribute any Content that violates the intellectual property rights of third parties or that is obscene, pornographic, or promotes hate speech.

CloudSync reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to monitor, investigate, and take appropriate action against any activity that violates these Acceptable Use policies. Such actions may include the removal of Content, suspension of access, or termination of the account without prior notice. By using the Service, you indemnify and hold CloudSync harmless from any claims, damages, or expenses arising from your violation of these usage guidelines or your misuse of the platform.
